newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduras CPI rises 1.7 pct in September.
newsitem.headline: Honduras CPI rises 1.7 pct in September.

text.p: Honduras' consumer price index rose 1.7 percent in September, bringing accumulated price increases for the first nine months to 19.9 percent, the central bank said on Friday.

A central bank official said the September CPI was less than the 2.8 percent, notched up in August. However, accumulated inflation so far this year has already exceeded the government's year-end target of 16 percent.
The bank said inflation was bolstered by a 6.8 percent increase in clothing prices and a 3.4 percent rise in personal care products.
In the first nine months of last year, inflation was 20.9 percent and it was 26.8 percent for the full year of 1995.
Economists and businessmen estimate this year's inflation will exceed 25 percent.
